# Input data and generated files

## Image feature extraction

`matlab/extract_rgb_channels.m` expects cropped JPEG images in a folder named
`裁剪` under the MATLAB current folder. It writes `GaussianFitResults.xlsx`
with the following columns:

- `FileName`
- `R_mu`
- `G_mu`
- `B_mu`

## Colour-space conversion

`matlab/rgb_to_hsv_lab_converter.m` accepts a CSV file, an Excel workbook, a
MATLAB workspace variable, or manually entered RGB values. Tabular input must
contain three RGB columns. The script validates the numerical range and asks
the user where to save the converted values.

## Reference and transfer models

The model scripts require tables containing these exact variable names:

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `R_norm` | Normalised red-channel feature |
| `G_norm` | Normalised green-channel feature |
| `B_norm` | Normalised blue-channel feature |
| `watercontent` | Gravimetric water content expressed as a fraction |

The scripts use these default filenames in the MATLAB current folder:

- `室内数据.csv`: laboratory observations used by the reference and transfer models
- `室外18.csv`: field validation observations used for direct application of the reference model
- `室外90.csv`: field observations used for adaptation and held-out testing
- `final_model_tuned.mat`: reference model generated by `train_reference_model.m`

The public data release uses descriptive English filenames. To run the scripts
without changing their default paths, copy `130 sets of indoor data.csv` to the
MATLAB current folder as `室内数据.csv`, and copy `90 sets of field data.csv`
as `室外90.csv`. The 90-row field table is the complete field dataset used by
`train_transfer_model.m`, which selects the 18-row held-out test subset after
setting `rng(42)`.

`validate_reference_model.m` expects a separately prepared `室外18.csv` file.
That derivative file is not supplied as a separate source table. Users who
reconstruct it must retain the exact 18 test indices generated by
`train_transfer_model.m`; a new random split will not reproduce the reported
direct-transfer evaluation.

If the default field-data files are absent, the relevant scripts open a file
selection dialog. The laboratory filename can be changed near the beginning of
the model scripts.

Principal outputs include model files, prediction tables, performance reports,
and figure files. Generated `.mat`, `.csv`, `.xlsx`, `.txt`, and image files are
excluded from normal Git commits by `.gitignore`. The approved source images
and CSV tables are distributed separately through the repository's
`data-v1.0.0` GitHub release.

## Surface-roughness utility

`matlab/quantify_surface_roughness.m` expects `soil1.jpg` to `soil4.jpg` in the
MATLAB current folder. It reports the pore area ratio, pore density, pore
connectivity, their range-normalised values, and the weighted PEDI. The current
version displays the result table and PEDI bar chart but does not write an
output workbook automatically.
